faceid.title: Face ID
faceid.cmd.live: Who came: the Face ID feed
faceid.privacy: Faces stay on the terminal: Daybook keeps each scan's time and snapshot only, and deletes snapshots after the days you set. Ask employees to agree in writing.
faceid.live.title: Live feed
faceid.live.description: Every face at the terminals, as it happens, with its snapshot.
faceid.live.emptyBody: The first face at the terminal will appear here.
faceid.live.more: The latest {shown} of {total} scans. Filter by terminal or result to narrow it.
faceid.kpi.strangers: {n} unknown faces | {n} unknown face | {n} unknown faces
faceid.feed.strangerHint: The terminal didn't recognise this face
faceid.flagHint.clock_off: The terminal's clock is off, so this scan has the time it reached Daybook.
faceid.flagHint.delivered_late: This scan reached Daybook more than 30 minutes late (the terminal was offline), so no messages went out.
faceid.flagHint.other_branch: The person's shift is at another branch.
faceid.flagHint.missed_entry: A check-out scan without a check-in: they were checked in at this scan.
faceid.flagHint.late_check_out: This is the real check-out, in place of the automatic one.
faceid.flagHint.already_in: The person was already checked in.
faceid.flagHint.out_of_order: Older than the person's attendance record, so it changed nothing.
faceid.flagHint.not_approved: The person isn't active in Daybook.
faceid.flagHint.ignored_number: This number is set aside: its scans are logged only.
faceid.scan.title: Scan
faceid.scan.gone: This scan isn't on the page any more.
faceid.people.title: People
faceid.people.description: Everyone the terminals know: who each number is in Daybook, or who isn't there yet.
faceid.people.setAside: Set aside: scans are logged only
faceid.people.linked: Linked. Their scans count from now on
faceid.people.unlinkBody: Its next scans won't count for {name} until it is linked again.
faceid.people.whoIsBody: Link the number to a Daybook person: this scan and the next ones count for them.
faceid.people.allLinkedBody: Every number the terminals saw is a Daybook person.
faceid.people.emptyBody: People appear here after their first scan at a terminal.
faceid.terminals.title: Terminals
faceid.terminals.description: The face recognition terminals at your staff doors, and how they are doing.
faceid.terminals.clockBehind: The terminal's clock is {n} min behind: its scans get the time they arrive. Set its time (NTP, GMT+05:00).
faceid.terminals.clockAhead: The terminal's clock is {n} min ahead: its scans get the time they arrive. Set its time (NTP, GMT+05:00).
faceid.terminals.neverHint: Waiting for the terminal's first event: type the setup values into it.
faceid.terminals.newCodeBody: The old address stops working at once: type the new URL into the terminal right after.
faceid.terminals.newCodeDone: New code ready: type the new URL into the terminal
faceid.terminals.offBody: Its scans are ignored until you switch it on again.
faceid.terminals.emptyBody: Add the face recognition terminal at your staff door: three steps, a few minutes.
faceid.direction.toggleHint: First scan in, next one out
faceid.wizard.title: Add a terminal
faceid.wizard.description: Hikvision face recognition terminal (MinMoe DS-K1T341AMF and the like).
faceid.wizard.name: Name
faceid.wizard.nameHint: Shown in the feed and in Telegram, e.g. "Kirish".
faceid.wizard.needNameBranch: Give the terminal a name and a branch.
faceid.wizard.open: On a computer in the pharmacy, open the terminal's address (e.g. http://192.168.1.250) and sign in as admin.
faceid.wizard.path: Configuration › Network › Advanced Settings › HTTP Listening
faceid.wizard.fill: Fill in the first free slot exactly like this, then Save:
faceid.wizard.pageTitle: Configuration › Network › Advanced Settings › HTTP Listening
faceid.wizard.protocolNote: HTTPS keeps the events private on the way.
faceid.wizard.copyFailed: Couldn't copy: select the text and copy it by hand
faceid.wizard.fallback: If the terminal doesn't save HTTPS, choose HTTP and port {port}, with the same host and URL.
faceid.wizard.people: Each person on the terminal keeps their Employee No: Daybook links the numbers to people by name, and you link the rest on the People page.
faceid.wizard.waiting: Scan a face at the terminal now…
faceid.wizard.waitingBody: This turns green the moment its first event reaches Daybook.
faceid.wizard.connectedBody: The terminal talks to Daybook. Its scans appear in the live feed.
faceid.wizard.tested: Test scan received: this is how scans appear in the feed. It doesn't count.
faceid.settings.title: Face ID settings
faceid.settings.description: What a scan sets off: attendance, Telegram messages and how long snapshots are kept.
faceid.settings.attendanceHint: Scans of people linked to Daybook can check them in and out.
faceid.settings.attendance: Scans check people in and out
faceid.settings.attendanceOn: The first scan of a shift is the check-in, the next one the check-out, with every Attendance rule.
faceid.settings.attendanceOff: Attendance is off for the company, so scans only fill the feed and Telegram.
faceid.settings.notifyEmployeeHint: The bot says "You came in: 08:57, Chilonzor." and, on leaving, the hours worked.
faceid.settings.repeatHint: A second scan this soon after the last changes nothing.
faceid.settings.telegramHint: Managers who see the branch get the snapshot with each message.
faceid.settings.telegram.arrivalsHint: Each person's first scan of the day
faceid.settings.telegram.offHint: Only new numbers, once a day
faceid.settings.groupPosts: Post arrivals in the branch's groups
faceid.settings.groupPhotosHint: Group posts carry the terminal's photo.
faceid.settings.strangersHint: With the snapshot, at most every 10 minutes per terminal.
faceid.settings.privacyHint: Snapshots are private: only people who see the branch's attendance open them.
faceid.settings.photoDaysHint: Deleted after this many days. 0: none are kept.
